Class Result<T, E>

Namespace
NuvTools.Common.ResultWrapper
Assembly
NuvTools.Common.dll

Represents an operation result that returns success data (T) and can also capture a typed error payload (E) for APIs that return non-standard error contracts.

public class Result<T, E> : Result<T>, IResult<T, E>, IResult<T>, IResult

Type Parameters

T

Type of the success data.

E

Type of the typed error payload returned on failure.

ErrorPayload
